_about: Public-domain F. W. Krummacher (1796-1868, German Reformed preacher, court chaplain at Potsdam) in pre-1930 English translations: Elijah the Tishbite (Nelson, 1869), The Suffering Saviour (tr. Samuel Jackson, 2nd ed., 1856), The Risen Redeemer (tr. John T. Betts, 1863), The Martyr Lamb (5th ed., 1845), The Dew of Israel and the Lily of God (1840) and his Autobiography (ed. his daughter, tr. M. G. Easton, 1869), raw Internet Archive OCR. Translators unnamed on the title page are recorded as unnamed. Not F. A. or G. D. Krummacher. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 15 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

fwkrummacher-elijah-1869: Elijah the Tishbite (London, Edinburgh and New York: T. Nelson, 1869; translator not named)
fwkrummacher-suffering-saviour-1856: The Suffering Saviour, tr. Samuel Jackson, second edition revised (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLVI)
fwkrummacher-risen-redeemer-1863: The Risen Redeemer, tr. John T. Betts (New York: Robert Carter, 1863)
fwkrummacher-martyr-lamb-1845: The Martyr Lamb, fifth edition (New York: Robert Carter, 1845; translator not named)
fwkrummacher-dew-of-israel-1840: The Dew of Israel and the Lily of God (New York: Robert Carter, 1840, from the second London edition; translator not named)
fwkrummacher-autobiography-1869: Friedrich Wilhelm Krummacher: An Autobiography, ed. his daughter, tr. M. G. Easton (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLXIX)
